Publish Simple Hackintosh CLI v3.1.0 from the main branch.

This release adds a boxed seven-section macOS Compatibility Checker based on the official OpCore-Simplify Hardware Sniffer report. It covers CPU, GPU and connected monitors, sound and audio endpoints, network, storage controllers, Bluetooth, and SD controllers. Windows hardware-report runs save both Hardware-Compatibility.txt and Hardware-Report.md while preserving the original Report.json schema.

The CLI checks the latest stable Simple Hackintosh and Hardware Sniffer releases at startup. Hardware Sniffer updates are checked against the official GitHub SHA-256 digest before the executable is cached or launched. The CLI itself is never silently replaced. Checks fail open when offline.

The ZIP includes the Windows CMD and PowerShell launchers, macOS Terminal launcher, cross-platform hardware inventory and diagnostics, and bundled macrecovery downloader source only. Apple Recovery payloads are not included.
